repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The candidate incorrectly placed the cycle counter `n` and the break condition inside the sustain block, causing the automation to stop after 30 seconds even though the IR requires 30 seconds of sustained input followed by a 15-second cycle that repeats twice. The `break` at line 7 prevents the second iteration of the cycle from executing. The IR structure is `wait` (sustain) followed by `cycle` (repetition), not a nested loop.
diagnosis.change_summary: Replaced the nested `if (n >= 2)` logic with a flat `wait` for the sustain condition followed by an expanded `cycle` body. The sustain threshold is corrected to `hold_ticks >= 31` (30 seconds at 100ms grid + 1 tick). The cycle body is written out explicitly with `delay(15 SEC)` between iterations and a `break` only after the final iteration.
